candidate_followups: Audit Decodex app-server and remote executor paths for assumptions that selected environment cwd is always a local absolute path.
Preserve target environment shell metadata when routing remote unified exec commands.
Surface foreign-cwd conversion failures as remote environment path compatibility problems instead of generic command failures.
caveats: The PR keeps request-permissions host-cwd limitations explicit instead of making every permission path cross-host.
The compatibility risk applies to multi-environment app-server and remote-exec integrations, not ordinary local-only CLI turns.
Decodex implementation work still needs a separate issue if local Control Plane code currently rewrites remote cwd or shell state.
evidence: `TurnEnvironmentSelection.cwd` is now a `PathUri` and remote primary cwd values are not overwritten by the local fallback.
Environment resolution records the selected environment shell from environment info.
Unified exec command construction uses the selected turn environment shell before falling back to the session shell.
Remote Windows test coverage asserts commands start through `pwsh.exe`.
observed_change: Codex carries selected turn environment cwd as `PathUri`, preserves non-local primary cwd selections, and builds unified exec commands with the selected remote environment shell.
social_notes: Frame this as remote exec correctness for cross-OS app-server environments.
Do not imply request-permissions now supports arbitrary foreign-environment paths.

items.title: [codex] exec-server honors remote environment cwd and shell
